# Plan readiness, `--refs`, needs-info and planner fix rounds (`planAttempts`)

## What to build

The engine's plan stage (`packages/graph-execution/src/plan/`, added by the previous slice: `--content`, `runPlanned` in `src/runner/run.ts`, `planStage` in `src/plan/stage.ts`, the `plan` object in `state.json`) learns readiness and retries. The planner now first decides whether the content can be built, in the same invocation as the planning, and reports it in `plan/result.json`:

- **Without refs** the content is one unit: `{ "name": "<name>", "ready": true, "questions": [] }`, or `{ "ready": false, "questions": ["…"] }` with no files written.
- **With refs** (new option `--refs <file>`, a JSON array `[{ "ref": "KAN-41", "url": "…", "title": "…" }]`): `{ "name": "<name>", "ready": ["KAN-41"], "notReady": [{ "ref": "KAN-42", "questions": ["…"] }] }`. The planner plans only the ready refs.

Nothing ready → the run ends `needs-info` (final) with exit code `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` (4) and the questions in `state.json` (`plan.questions`, `plan.dropped`). Some refs not ready → they go to `plan.dropped` with their questions, and the ready ones go on (gate or run, as before). When the result or the planned folder is invalid, the planner is run again with the error text in its prompt, up to `planAttempts` rounds (new config key, default 3, also `--plan-attempts <n>`); after the last failed round the run ends `failed` with the error in `plan.error` and in the failure summary graph-manager shows. The fake provider gets `NOT-READY: <ref>` / `NOT-READY` markers so all of this can be tested without a real agent.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/automation-api.md` ("Decisions": refs, needs-info, planAttempts; "Requirements > Engine > Planner / Plan loop / Fake provider"; "Acceptance criteria" 4–6).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/stage.ts`, `src/plan/prompt.ts`, `src/plan/result.ts`, `src/plan/paths.ts` — the plan stage as it is now (one round, loose result schema `{ name }`, prompt builder, `PLAN_RESULT_PATH_PATTERN`, `PLAN_CONTENT_PATH_PATTERN`, `planDir`, `planResultPath`, `planContentPath`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` — `runPlanned` (creates the run in `planning`, calls `planStage`, on failure sets `plan.error`, status `failed` and throws `AbortRunError` with step `planning`; on success commits and either returns `EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL` or calls `execute`), and `finish` (lines 145–154: removes every worktree of the run).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` — `planStateSchema` (`contentPath, refs, gate, name?, attempts, questions: [{ref?, questions}], dropped, feedback, error?`) and `planRefSchema` (`{ ref, url?, title? }`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/errors.ts` — `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO` = 4 already exists.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/launch/preflight.ts` — `preflight()` branch for `opts.content` (kind `plan`), `checkInputFile`, `preflightResume` (already refuses `needs-info` runs as final).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts` — `RunOptions`, `overridesOf` (lines 95–104), `runPlannedGraph`, the `--web` launcher preflight options, `serveWeb` (closes the page and exits on `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`/`EXIT_AWAITING_APPROVAL`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/config/config.ts` (lines 8–42 `configSchema`, 51–69 `overridesSchema`/`OVERRIDE_FLAGS`) — where `planAttempts` goes.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/paths.ts` (lines 39–51 `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/fake.ts` — the planner mode (`opts.role === "planner"`: writes `docs/prd/fake-plan.md`, `.agents/tasks/fake-plan/1.json`, the `attempt.write` files, then the result from `attempt.result` or the default `{ name, ready: true, questions: [] }`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/agents/tester.ts` / `src/agents/reviewer.ts` — "## Previous attempt" sections: how a retried agent is told why its last attempt was rejected (search `Previous attempt`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` (lines 205–231 `failureOf`) — the failure label graph-manager shows; add the planning error.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal.ts` (`scanArgs`, sandbox-runs) and `apps/graph-manager/src/server/sandbox-paths.ts` (`PATH_OPTIONS`) — `--refs` is a path option in a sandbox.
- Tests to mirror: `src/plan/stage.test.ts` (in-process `runPlanned` with `createFakeProvider`), `src/cli.test.ts` (the `--content` tests and the `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS` test at line 62), `src/config/config.test.ts`, `src/providers/fake.test.ts`, `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts` (search `failureOf`).

## Patterns to follow

**Schema and parse errors (zod v4, mirror `src/plan/result.ts` / `src/state/state.ts`):**
```typescript
const parsed = schema.safeParse(json);
if (!parsed.success) return { ok: false, error: `${file} is invalid: ${z.prettifyError(parsed.error)}` };
```

**Config key with a run flag (mirror `attempts`, config.ts:21, 52, 63 and cli.ts:96-103, 228):**
```typescript
attempts: z.number().int().min(1).default(3),          // configSchema
attempts: z.number().int().min(1).optional(),          // overridesSchema
attempts: "--attempts",                                // OVERRIDE_FLAGS
.option("--attempts <n>", "attempts for every agent invocation; overrides attempts in the config (default: 3)", parsePositiveInt)
```

**Retry prompt section (mirror the tester's "## Previous attempt"):**
```
## Previous attempt
The engine rejected your previous attempt: <error text>. Fix the files and write the result file again.
```

**Usage errors:** `throw new UsageError("...")` from `src/launch/preflight.ts` → exit 2 before any run folder exists.

**Test pattern:** in process with `createFakeProvider(script)` and `runPlanned` (see `src/plan/stage.test.ts`); prompts are in `provider.calls[i].prompt`. Out of process: `src/cli.test.ts` `run([...], repo, { GRAPH_EXECUTION_FAKE_SCRIPT: file })`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/result.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `unitResultSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().regex(PLAN_NAME_PATTERN).optional(), ready: z.boolean(), questions: z.array(z.string().min(1)).default([]) })` with a check: `ready === true` needs `name`; `ready === false` needs at least one question.
  - `refsResultSchema = z.object({ name: z.string().regex(PLAN_NAME_PATTERN).optional(), ready: z.array(z.string()), notReady: z.array(z.object({ ref: z.string(), questions: z.array(z.string().min(1)).min(1) })).default([]) })` with checks against the run's refs: every ref appears exactly once across `ready` and `notReady`; no unknown ref; `name` required when `ready` is non-empty.
  - `readPlanResult(file, refs: PlanRef[])` returns `{ ok: true; readiness: { name?: string; ready: string[] | boolean; notReady: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[] } } | { ok: false; error }`, choosing the schema by `refs.length > 0`. Normalise both shapes to: `nothingReady: boolean`, `name?`, `dropped: string[]` (refs not ready), `questions: { ref?: string; questions: string[] }[]`.
- **GOTCHA**: Error texts go verbatim into the planner's next prompt and into `plan.error`: make them say what to fix, e.g. `ref KAN-9 is not one of the run's refs (KAN-41, KAN-42)`, `ref KAN-41 is missing: put it in ready or notReady`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/result.test.ts` (from `packages/graph-execution`)

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/paths.ts` and `src/plan/prompt.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `planRefsPath(runDir) = path.join(planDir(runDir), "refs.json")`.
  - `PLAN_REFS_PATH_PATTERN = /The refs are in this file: \`([^\`]+)\`/` and `planRefsPathLine`.
  - `PlannerPromptInput` adds `refs: PlanRef[]`, `refsPath?: string`, `previousError?: string`.
  - Prompt additions, after `## Content`:
    - With refs: `## Refs` — `planRefsPathLine(refsPath)` and one line per ref `- KAN-41: <title> (<url>)`; "The content describes these items. First decide, for each ref, whether it can be built as written, without a human answering a question. Plan only the ready refs, all in one spec and one task folder, and name each ready ref's ticket key in the spec's Goals. Do not plan a ref that is not ready: list it under notReady with the questions a human must answer."
    - Without refs: "First decide whether the content can be built as written, without a human answering a question. If it cannot, write no spec and no tasks; write only the result file with `ready: false` and your questions."
    - `## Previous attempt` (only with `previousError`): "The engine rejected your previous attempt: <error>. Fix the files (they are still in your working directory) and write the result file again."
  - `## Result` describes the shape for the case at hand (the two JSON shapes from "What to build"); `name` is omitted when nothing is ready.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/prompt.test.ts`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/plan/stage.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `planStage` input adds `refs: PlanRef[]`, `previousError?: string`, `feedback: string[]` (pass `[]` for now; a later slice fills it). Before the agent runs, `rm` the old result file (already done) so a stale one never passes.
  - New result: `{ ok: true; kind: "planned"; name; commit; tasks; dropped; questions } | { ok: true; kind: "needs-info"; dropped; questions } | { ok: false; error }`. When nothing is ready return `needs-info` without checking or committing any file. Otherwise run the existing name/spec/tasks checks and the commit.
- **GOTCHA**: Do not reset the worktree between rounds: the planner fixes its own files. `commitPaths` already folds and cleans everything at the end.

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (`runPlanned`)

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `PlannedRunOptions` adds `refs: PlanRef[]` and `refsFile?: string`. At start copy the refs to `planRefsPath(runDir)` (`JSON.stringify(refs, null, 2)`) when there are any, and save them in `plan.refs`.
  - The round loop: for `round = 1..config.planAttempts`: save `plan.attempts = round`; log `planning: attempt <round>/<n>`; `planStage({ ..., refs, previousError })`; `ok: false` → `previousError = error`, log `planning: attempt <round>/<n> rejected: <error>` and continue; `ok: true` → stop. After the loop with no success: the existing failure path with the message `planning failed after <n> attempt(s): <last error>` (`plan.error` = the last error text).
  - `needs-info`: `plan.questions`, `plan.dropped` (all refs, or `[]` without refs), `status = "needs-info"`, save; `await finish("success", ctx)` (removes the worktrees; the branch and run folder stay); log `needs info: <n> question(s); the questions are in state.json (plan.questions)` plus each `ref: question` line; return `{ exitCode: EXIT_NEEDS_INFO, state: store }`.
  - `planned` with dropped refs: save `plan.dropped` and `plan.questions` together with the other end-of-planning fields; log `dropped <refs>: not ready (see plan.questions)`; then gate/run as before.
- **GOTCHA**: `finish("success", …)` returns `EXIT_SUCCESS`; ignore it and return `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`. Release the lock in the existing `finally`. `serveWeb` in `cli.ts` already closes the page and exits for `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/plan/stage.test.ts`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/config/config.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `planAttempts: z.number().int().min(1).default(3)` in `configSchema` (doc: "Planner rounds for a `--content` run: on an invalid result or task folder the planner gets the error and tries again"), `planAttempts` in `overridesSchema`, `OVERRIDE_FLAGS.planAttempts = "--plan-attempts"`.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/config/config.test.ts`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.ts`, `src/launch/preflight.ts`, `src/state/paths.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - Options `--refs <file>` ("with --content: a JSON array [{ref, url?, title?}]; only unclear refs are dropped") and `--plan-attempts <n>` (`parsePositiveInt`, "planner rounds for --content; overrides planAttempts (default: 3)"). `RunOptions` adds `refs?: string; planAttempts?: number`; `overridesOf` adds `planAttempts: opts.planAttempts`.
  - `preflight` (`content` branch): `--refs` without `--content` → `UsageError("--refs needs --content")`; read and check the refs file: missing → `refs file not found: <f>`; not JSON → `refs file <f> is not valid JSON: <msg>`; `z.array(planRefSchema)` fails → `refs file <f> is invalid: <prettified>`; duplicate refs → `refs file <f> lists <ref> twice`. Return the parsed refs in the `plan` result (`refs: PlanRef[]`, `[]` without the option). `--plan-attempts` on `--resume` is refused by the existing overrides check (`OVERRIDE_FLAGS`).
  - `runPlannedGraph` passes `refs` to `runPlanned`; add `refs` to the `--web` launcher preflight options and to the resume preflight (`--resume --refs` → covered by the `--content` message: extend it to "--resume takes no tasks folder, --spec, --content, --refs or --provider").
  - `RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS` adds `"--refs"` and `"--plan-attempts"`.
- **GOTCHA**: An empty array `[]` in the refs file means "no refs" (the content is one unit).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution && npx vitest run src/cli.test.ts -t "refs|plan-attempts|RUN_VALUE_OPTIONS"`

### UPDATE `packages/graph-execution/src/providers/fake.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: in planner mode read the content file from `PLAN_CONTENT_PATH_PATTERN` and the refs from `PLAN_REFS_PATH_PATTERN` (absent → no refs). Lines (trimmed) `NOT-READY: <ref>` mark that ref not ready with one question `What is missing for <ref>?`; a line exactly `NOT-READY` without refs makes the whole content not ready with the question `What should be built?`. Default result: with refs `{ name, ready: [<ready refs>], notReady: [...] }` (no `name` and no files when none is ready); without refs `{ name, ready: true, questions: [] }` or `{ ready: false, questions: [...] }` with no files. `attempt.result` still overrides the result and `attempt.write` still adds files.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/providers/fake.test.ts`

### UPDATE graph-manager (`apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`, `routes/internal.ts`, `sandbox-paths.ts`)

- **IMPLEMENT**: `failureOf`: for `failed` with `state.plan?.error` (and no task failed) return `planning failed: <first line of plan.error, at most 200 chars>`; this must win over the generic `"failed"`. `PATH_OPTIONS` adds `"--refs"`; the sandbox-runs route checks that a `--refs` file is inside the workspace like `--content` (400 `refs: <x> is not a file inside the workspace`).
- **VALIDATE**: `npm run build -w graph-execution && cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/runs.test.ts src/server/routes/internal.test.ts src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts`

### UPDATE docs: `packages/graph-execution/README.md`, `TESTING.md`

- **IMPLEMENT**: README: rows for `--refs <file>` and `--plan-attempts <n>`, `planAttempts` in the configuration table, the `needs-info` status, and exit code row `4` (needs info: nothing was ready; the questions are in `state.json` under `plan.questions`; final, start a new run). TESTING.md: the `NOT-READY: <ref>` / `NOT-READY` lines of the fake planner, with an example refs file.

### CREATE / UPDATE tests

- `src/plan/result.test.ts`: both shapes; missing/unknown/duplicate refs; `ready: true` without name; `ready: false` without questions.
- `src/plan/stage.test.ts` (regression for the acceptance criteria):
  - content `NOT-READY`, no refs → `EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`, status `needs-info`, `plan.questions == [{ questions: ["What should be built?"] }]`, no `Plan:` commit on `graph/<id>`, worktrees removed.
  - refs `A`, `B` and content `NOT-READY: B` → `plan.dropped == ["B"]`, `plan.questions == [{ ref: "B", questions: ["What is missing for B?"] }]`, the run goes on (gate off → `applied`).
  - refs `A`, `B`, both `NOT-READY` → `needs-info`, `dropped == ["A", "B"]`.
  - fake script `planner:plan` with 3 attempts writing a self-dependent `.agents/tasks/fake-plan/1.json` → state `failed`, `plan.attempts == 3`, `plan.error` contains `depends on itself`, and `provider.calls[1].prompt` contains `## Previous attempt` and `depends on itself`.
  - first attempt invalid, second valid → run goes on, `plan.attempts == 2`.
- `src/cli.test.ts`: `--content` with `NOT-READY` exits 4; `--refs` without `--content` exits 2; an invalid refs file exits 2 before a run folder exists; `--plan-attempts 1` is saved in `state.overrides` and refused on `--resume`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts`: `failureOf("failed", undefined, stateWithPlanError)` → `planning failed: …`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Content with `NOT-READY` and no refs ends `needs-info` with exit 4 (`EXIT_NEEDS_INFO`) and the questions in `state.json`.
- [ ] Content with refs `A`, `B` and `NOT-READY: B` drops `B` (`plan.dropped == ["B"]`, questions for `B`) and plans `A`.
- [ ] A planner that writes an invalid task folder gets the validation error in its next prompt; after `planAttempts` failures the run ends `failed` with the error in `plan.error` and graph-manager's failure label `planning failed: …`.
- [ ] `--refs` without `--content`, a missing, invalid or duplicate refs file → exit 2, no run folder.
- [ ] `planAttempts` is a config key (default 3) and `--plan-attempts <n>` overrides it for the run.
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm run build -w graph-execution && npm test -w graph-execution && npm test -w graph-manager`

```bash
cd packages/graph-execution && npx vitest run src/plan src/cli.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/providers/fake.test.ts src/launch/preflight.test.ts && cd ../..
cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/runs.test.ts src/server/routes/internal.test.ts src/server/sandbox-paths.test.ts && cd ../..

# Whole suite
npm test
```
